verdict: TRUTHFUL THREE-ARM FAILED A/B. All three arms completed 0 of 7 ls20 levels. The single behavioral change vision produced is real but incomplete: with a vision-capable model (qwen35b-arc) seeing the BEFORE|CURRENT composite, the EWM agent DID cross the threshold the text-only run never reached -- it left reactive RECOVER mode, entered SYNTHESIZE/EXECUTE, and ADOPTED a world-model program (program_adopted:true vs false text-only). So vision unblocked *program synthesis*. But it did NOT unblock *valid* synthesis: the adopted program was accepted provisionally against zero transitions, then mispredicted all 80 observed transitions (divergences=80, empirical pass_rate 0.0), so the search planner never had a faithful model to solve a level with. Net: vision moved the bottleneck one step downstream -- from 'model cannot even author a program from raw frames' (text-only) to 'model authors a program but it does not match ls20 dynamics' (vision) -- without yet clearing a level. A required enabling fix was also found and landed: qwen35b-arc is a thinking model that, with thinking ON, spends its whole token budget in the reasoning field and returns empty content, so it could never emit a program; disabling thinking via reasoning_effort:none (new ARC_LLM_REASONING_EFFORT env knob) is what let synthesis engage at all. Live wiring worked end-to-end on all arms (real sessions, actions submitted, scorecards opened/closed).
